mapper.select: SELECT t.type,t.person_id,t.organization_id,t.label,t.distinguishing_label FROM ( SELECT 'PLATFORM' type,NULL person_id,NULL organization_id,#{platformLabel} label,'平台范围' distinguishing_label UNION ALL SELECT 'ORGANIZATION',NULL,id,name,CONCAT(type,' · ',id) FROM person_organization WHERE 1=1 AND status='ACTIVE' AND type IN ('PARTY_COMMITTEE','PARTY_GENERAL_BRANCH','PARTY_BRANCH') UNION ALL SELECT 'PERSON',id,NULL,real_name,CONCAT('人员 · ',id) FROM person_profile WHERE status='ACTIVE' ) t WHERE t.type IN #{x} AND ( (t.type=#{c.type} AND 1=1t.person_id=#{c.personId}t.organization_id=#{c.organizationId}) 1=0) AND LOCATE(#{q},t.label)>0 ORDER BY t.type,COALESCE(t.person_id,t.organization_id,'') LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM person_membership m JOIN person_organization o ON o.id=m.organization_id AND o.status='ACTIVE' WHERE m.person_id=p.id AND m.organization_id=#{memberOrganization} AND m.ended_event_id IS NULL AND m.valid_from<=#{at} AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until>#{at}))
mapper.select: SELECT x.* FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('USER:',u.id) candidate_id,u.id user_id,NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname),'') nickname,p.id person_id,p.real_name,p.status person_status FROM user_profile u LEFT JOIN person_account_binding b ON b.user_id=u.id AND b.status='ACTIVE' AND b.ended_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN person_profile p ON p.id=b.person_id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND (b.id IS NULL OR (b.verification_method IN ('ADMIN_MANUAL','ROSTER_EXACT_MATCH') AND b.source_reference IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(b.source_reference)<>'')) AND UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PERSON:',p.id),NULL,NULL,p.id,p.real_name,p.status FROM person_profile p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM person_account_binding b WHERE b.person_id=p.id AND b.status='ACTIVE') AND ) x WHERE 1=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM person_membership m JOIN person_organization o ON o.id=m.organization_id AND o.status='ACTIVE' WHERE m.person_id=x.person_id AND m.organization_id=#{filter} AND m.ended_event_id IS NULL AND m.valid_from<=#{at} AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until>#{at})) AND (LOCATE(#{q},x.real_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{q},x.nickname)>0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM person_membership m JOIN person_organization o ON o.id=m.organization_id AND o.status='ACTIVE' WHERE m.person_id=x.person_id AND m.ended_event_id IS NULL AND m.valid_from<=#{at} AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until>#{at}) AND o.id=#{memberOrganization}AND o.id=#{filter} AND LOCATE(#{q},o.name)>0)) ORDER BY candidate_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT MIN(boundary) FROM ( SELECT MIN(valid_from) boundary FROM person_membership WHERE valid_from>#{at} AND ended_event_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT MIN(valid_until) FROM person_membership WHERE valid_until>#{at} AND ended_event_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT MIN(CONVERT_TZ(ban_expire_at,'+08:00','+00:00')) FROM user_profile WHERE ban_expire_at>CONVERT_TZ(#{at},'+00:00','+08:00') ) b
